## spaci: Spatial causal inference under confounding and interference

**spaci** is an R package for estimating causal effects from spatial observational data when spatial confounding and spatial interference may occur simultaneously.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Ogunsolaia/spaci)
- [CRAN package page](https://cran.r-project.org/package=spaci)

### Main methods

**iDAPS** (`idaps()`): a distance-adjusted propensity-score matching approach incorporating spatial and neighbourhood exposure information.

**RecoverU+** (`recoveru_plus()`): an approach incorporating partially recovered spatial confounding and neighbourhood exposure in causal effect estimation.

### Installation

```{.r}
install.packages("spaci")
library(spaci)
packageVersion("spaci")
```

### Start exploring

Consult the package documentation and GitHub README for the current function signatures and examples. The exact API may change across releases.

### Reproducible research

My software work aims to make methodological research accessible through documented R functions, simulation tools, and reproducible examples.
